column1: # live_sorters.tsv -- every sign-sorter page published to the owner, one row per artifact (owner rule R06, tools/data/sorter_owner_requirements.tsv:
# "Why we make same mistakes over and over?" -- pages already sent get every later fix). Started 10 Oct 2026 16:3x UTC by the account-3 parent's
# build worker (template 2026-10-09.5, R05). tools/live_sorters_check.py lists every row whose template_marker differs from
# tools/sign_sorter/template.html's marker as "stale: re-render and republish"; the account that owns the page reads it back (Artifact read),
# re-renders it (tools/sorter_rerender.py: DATA and sids byte for byte, so saved answers survive, R08; every row below predates the OPTS line,
# so the re-render puts its open questions in the tray and lands on step 2, R04, unless --no-focus-to-tray; questions in a pile already
# marked done / not a letter / merged stay decided), preflights it (tools/sorter_preflight.py,
# six checks) and republishes it to the same URL, then sets template_marker and last_republished here. Add a row in the same session that
# publishes a new sorter page. template_marker 'none' = the page carries no marker (built before markers). local_source_hint says where a
# local copy of the page was ('scratch' = a session scratchpad, not in this repository; read the artifact back instead).
# status (round-2 check, 10 Oct 2026, 21:4x UTC: 18 sorter pages on account 3 had no row, so the check passed silently for them): 'live' =
# the owner may still open it and it gets every later fix; 'retired YYYY-MM-DD: reason' = left alone on purpose (owner said done and the
# answers were exported, withdrawn, or replaced by a rebuild). template_marker 'unread' = never read back from the artifact (stale until
# re-rendered; the re-render reads it). After a republish, `python3 tools/live_sorters_check.py --record URL PAGE.html` writes the marker
# read from the page itself and the time -- never type it. Each account lists its own pages (account 3's below, from its Artifact list
# of 10 Oct 2026 21:2x UTC); duty 6 compares that list with these rows (--artifacts).
